fields.name: EffectEntity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D665F0 (the per-element handler of the drain loop in bg3.exe+0x2D660E0) passes *elem (8 bytes) as the entity argument of CreateEffect (bg3.exe+0x2D66670 ~ esv::EffectManager::CreateEffect), which becomes esv::Effect.Entity (Coverage.h); same role as ScriptLightPlayEffectOnEntityRequest.EffectEntity of the sibling esv::script::light singleton.

fields.name: Effect
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D665F0 passes elem+8 as the effect name to CreateEffect (assigned to esv::Effect.EffectName +0x28); the bg3.exe destructor bg3.exe+0x22AA5F0 -> 0x22E1F20 releases a FixedString here.

fields.name: _PadC
fields.evidence: Padding before the 8-byte member at +0x10; never read by bg3.exe+0x2D665F0.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D665F0 copies elem+0x10 as 8 bytes to esv::Effect+0x38 (Effect.Target in Coverage.h, the entity the effect is attached to).

fields.name: Bone
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D665F0 assigns the 4-byte FixedString at elem+0x18 to esv::Effect+0x2C (Effect.Bone in Coverage.h) with IncRef/DecRef; destructor releases it.

fields.name: Requests

Element named by the game ls::PlayEffectOnEntityRequest (Toolkit IndexedStorage assert in EoCServer.dll+0xCF3DD0). Live (seen.py, idle): empty.
